
DESCRIPTION
Run named workspace tasks with mise

USAGE
  one run [task] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one run
  one run build -p web
  one run test -p api
  one run build --dry-run

TIPS
Lists tasks with no arguments. Runs root tasks or selected project tasks with their dependencies. one <task> is shorthand for one run <task>, including dev, build, test, and lint. Built-in commands take precedence; use one run <task> for a conflicting name.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --cache <value>          Cache access: local-only, read-write, read-only, write-only, off
  --concurrency <value>    Maximum parallel tasks (dev allocates automatically when omitted)
  --dry-run                Preview tasks without preparing tools, dependencies, secrets, or caches
  --env <value>            One project environment name
  --force                  Bypass freshness checks; combine with --cache off to ensure execution
  --list                   List available tasks
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  -p, --project <value>    Project name or relative path (repeatable)
  --ui <value>             Output mode: auto, stream, raw
